description: This Java class defines a MonkeyGetFrameRateEvent used in Android's Monkey testing framework to measure and log the frame rate during UI rendering. It executes system commands, parses output, and calculates average frame rates for test scenarios.

classes.name: MonkeyGetFrameRateEvent
classes.description: A class that captures frame rate information by executing a system service call, parsing the output, and calculating the average frame rate during a test.

methods.name: getAverageFrameRate
methods.description: Calculates the average frame rate based on total number of frames and duration.

methods.name: writeAverageFrameRate
methods.description: Writes the calculated average frame rate to a log file on external storage.

methods.name: getNumberOfFrames
methods.description: Extracts the number of frames from the surfaceFlinger command output using regex.

methods.name: injectEvent
methods.description: Executes the system call to retrieve frame rate data, parses the output, updates timing and frame number counters, and logs the results.
